observations.behavior: Adds a GitHub Actions workflow step to upload CLI debug symbols, explicitly allowing the step to fail without blocking the release job.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows the PostHog CLI release pipeline to complete even if uploading debug symbols to S3 fails, preventing release delays caused by transient network or S3 availability issues.

observations.behavior: Adds a markdown documentation entry describing a fallback behavior for S3 symbol uploads.
observations.code_quote: Retry symbol set uploads through the standard S3 endpoint when the transfer-acceleration endpoint is unreachable, so uploads complete on networks that block the accelerate domain. A 5 second connect timeout on uploads makes unreachable endpoints fail fast.
observations.posthog_connection: Documents a reliability improvement where the CLI attempts to upload debug symbols using a standard S3 endpoint instead of a transfer-acceleration endpoint if the latter is unreachable, improving compatibility with restrictive networks.
